digest.component_or_area: LLM agent call toolset cutoff / tool_step_limit steering
propositions: Bedrock Converse and Anthropic reject requests that omit toolConfig when the message history contains toolUse/tool_use blocks, causing ValidationException 400 when tool_step_limit filtering empties the advertised tool surface after any tool call

The current .filtered() empty-cutoff mechanism in build_agent_kwargs hides tools mid-run, violating the provider protocol constraint and converting runs into LLMUnavailableError when they exceed the step limit

Tool definitions must remain advertised for the entire run to keep requests protocol-valid; instead of filtering out tools, steering should return a synthetic result telling the model tool results are no longer provided and it must answer from gathered evidence
A run exceeding tool_step_limit should land naturally through the existing output path with steering results, not raise a provider error mid-protocol
Steering is advisory; the terminal bound for non-cooperative models remains the existing UsageLimits budget (request_limit and tool_calls_limit), preventing infinite loops
